==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Gawyn Trakand]]}}
[[Gawyn Trakand|Gawyn]] contemplates life in the [[Royal Palace of Andor]]. He sent away [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]]'s last messenger without an answer. He realizes that he is jealous of [[Rand]] and the life he is leading, a life that Gawyn should be having, ruling nations and leading armies. Gawyn must step aside from leading and now serve Egwene as her [[Warder]] as he loves her. He sees [[Birgitte Silverbow]] and asks if he can say goodbye to [[Elayne Trakand]] as he plans to go back to the [[White Tower]]. Birgitte tells Gawyn that she is asleep attending to [[Aes Sedai]] matters. Gawyn pieces that Egwene is also probably there as well and then remembers [[Kaisea]]'s warning about the [[Bloodknife|Bloodknive]]s attacking when a person is at their most vulnerable. He sprints to the Traveling grounds and asks a [[Kin|Kinswoman]] for a gateway to the White Tower. He is surprised to see that the gateway closed suddenly behind him, almost cutting his leg off.{{ref|This is a result of the arrival of Perrin with the dreamspike.}}

:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}
Egwene appears with the [[Wise One]]s and [[Leane Sharif]] to where the [[Aes Sedai]] hiding. [[Saerin Asnobar]] reports that they were carrying out their fake ploy when the [[Black Ajah]] attacked. [[Shevan Gadarin]] and [[Carlinya Sorevin]] were killed in the initial assault. [[El'Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran|Nynaeve]] is still fighting in the Tower. Egwene asks Saerin to leave, but she can't. They look overhead and see a purple dome. Egwene sends all other Aes Sedai away to hide, while she takes Leane and the Wise Ones to hunt the Black Ajah and [[Mesaana]].

:{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}
Perrin has arrived at Tar Valon and the White Tower. [[Slayer]] appears behind [[Perrin Aybara|Perrin]] and he demands the [[dreamspike]] back. Perrin threatens to destroy it but Slayer knows Perrin doesn't have the strength; even Slayer doesn't have the strength to do that. Perrin notices that his eyes flicker to [[Dragonmount]] behind him. Slayer tells Perrin that Luc deeply hates Perrin and the two rush forward at each other.

:{{pov|[[Gawyn Trakand]]}}
Gawyn charges into the White Tower and comes across [[Celark]] and [[Mazone]], two former [[Younglings]]. He tells them to follow him. He reaches Egwene's room and enters. A Tower maid is held immobile by Air inside, having set off Egwene's traps. Gawyn rushes to check on the sleeping form of Egwene when he is attacked by two black blurs. Mazone runs to get more help while Celark helps Gawyn fight the two Bloodknives. Both Bloodknives turn on Celark and kill him. Gawyn plans to defend for as long as he can till help arrives. Gawyn then spots Mazone's fallen body outside the room. A third blur enters the room and they all attack in unison. 

:{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}
Perrin lets his inner wolf free and attacks Slayer. The two fight, using their weapons and changing the surroundings around them to their advantage. They arrive in a place filled with statues and Slayer manages to distract Perrin with a life-like statue of himself and cuts the pouch holding the dreamspike free. Slayer grabs the dreamspike and retreats. [[Hopper]] appears and they both follow Slayer. 

:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}
Egwene hides behind a wall taking a break from the fighting. She spots [[Evanellein Lorn]] and [[Mestra]] ahead. Egwene destroys Mestra with a [[Fire ball]] and makes Evanellein think she is stupid. [[Mesaana]] appears beside Egwene all wrapped in black. Egwene begins to question why she is even fighting and realizes that her mind is being manipulated. She shifts to her rooms. Nynaeve is there and nearly blasts Egwene, but they both head to the gardens. Nynaeve reports that Leane and Siuan are still alive and that Nynaeve managed to kill [[Notori]] with fire. Egwene suggests that 19 ''ter'angreal'' were stolen which is probably the amount of Black Ajah in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' now. The Wise Ones are still in the fight and seem to be enjoying themselves. Both women move to another area. Egwene consumes [[Sedore Dajenna]] by not channeling but creating fire. The two keep shifting from corridor to corridor. [[Bair]] appears telling them their pattern is obvious. They are then attacked by six women. 

:{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}
Slayer races through the Tower, Perrin hot on his heels. Hopper peels off to try and get ahead of him. As Perrin runs through the White Tower he sees Aes Sedai fighting. He calls out the Egwene, who tries to hold him in place. Perrin shrugs it off telling her she should not be in the dream. Egwene tries to again hold Perrin in place with ropes, but Perrin again shrugs them off. An unknown Black sister shoots [[Balefire]] at Perrin. He puts his palm up imagining the weave disappearing. It disintegrates the wall behind them and Egwene tears the wall down on top of the Black sister. Egwene is incredulous Perrin stopped balefire but he explains he doesn't have time to speak with her and runs off. Perrin asks Hopper where he is and receives a sending of pain in response.

:{{pov|[[Gawyn Trakand]]}}

Gawyn has been cut a dozen times in his fight with the Bloodknives. The Bloodknives are wearing him out on purpose, ready to strike when he is his weakest. Gawyn leaps forward and strikes one down. The two renew their onslaught on him. Gawyn remembers the phrase Kaisea  had said about 'where there is light, there is shadow' and knocks down the lantern in the room, plunging it into darkness. Gawyn waits and then strikes, his blade striking true leaving him with one more assassin. He can feel himself becoming faint and taps the floor on purpose. The assassin strikes low, hitting him in the side (a variant of [[Sheathing the Sword]]''')'''. Gawyn strikes high, beheading the final assassin, then falls to the floor unconscious.

:{{pov|[[Mesaana]]}}
[[Katerine Alruddin]] kneels at Mesaana's feet. Mesaana lashes her across her back in punishment. She is frustrated with the appearance of the dreamspike as it has stopped her from [[Traveling]] out to the area she had selected to battle the Egwene and her Aes Sedai. She wants to gain control of the dreamspike, so she can use it against the other [[Forsaken]] as well as Egwene. As she is about to send out Katerine again, she places an unnamed weave on her.{{ref|The weave is [[Mirror of Mists]] to disguise [[Katerine]] as [[Mesaana]].{{ref/book|13|38}}}}

:{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}
Perrin appears in front of Slayer. Slayer holds Hopper in one arm and a knife in the other. Slayer throws Hopper off the side of the building. Perrin leaps at Slayer and they both fall of the ledge. Slayer stabs Perrin in the arm with his knife. Perrin manages to get free of Slayer and land underneath Hopper, catching the wolf. Slayer then sends an arrow, which goes through Hopper and into Perrin's leg. As Slayer readies to shoot Perrin again, Perrin refuses to be killed and leave [[Faile Bashere|Faile]] alone so he rushes at Slayer imagining his leg being healed but Slayer tells him it doesn't work that way, knocking him down. Perrin smells terror and sees a nightmare behind Slayer. He drives both of them into the nightmare.
